entities.title: git-tools
entities.summary: `zazzle git`: a small git front end with a modeless terminal editor made for commit messages, pull request bodies, changelog entries and rebase todo lists, a commit flow that keeps a draft message and lets the developer choose the files, `amend` to reword the last commit (adding what is staged) and `undo` to take it back keeping its changes. One Rust package, three binaries.
entities.purpose: The crate of the git-tools, git-tools-commit and git-tools-commit-message-editor binaries: Cargo.toml, the user README, the library and binaries in src/, and the pseudo-terminal end-to-end tests in tests/. It is one member of the Cargo workspace in src/macos.
boundaries: It uses no other crate in the repository. The zazzle invoker (src/macos/zazzle) runs it for `zazzle git ARGS` by exec'ing the git-tools binary from the tools' folder (libexec/zazzle); it never goes through the zazzle daemon.
Everything except help, version, `message`, `commit`, `amend` and `undo` is handed to the real git unchanged; the crate only runs git as a separate program.
Building, CI (including its 95% line and branch coverage gate) and publishing the binaries are the workspace's and the workflows' concern, not this folder's.

relationships.description: The invoker that execs git-tools for `zazzle git`.
